name: generative_mcp
summary: Single front-door meta-connector for every generative modality. Does NOT call external services itself — every tool fans out to a sibling substrate connector that is already wired (ModelAPI, DeepSeek MCP, ComfyUI MCP, Blender MCP, Replit bridge). Each successful call appends one InferenceRecord with tier='generative', model='generative_mcp', scope='generative_<tool>', and the subordinate's crystal_id is preserved in metadata.sub_crystal so the fan-out chain stays traceable end-to-end. Stdlib only — urllib for the HTTP hop to studio/mcp/replit-bridge on port 8765.
engine_pattern: ThirdPartyConnector subclass mirroring stripe_mcp / deepseek_mcp shape. SERVICE='generative_mcp'. Every subordinate is imported behind try/except so a missing sibling never breaks the whole connector; per-tool readiness is reported via which_tools_available(). Tool dispatch via send(recipient=tool_name, message=json_args). connect() is auth-free (the meta-connector has no key surface of its own) and always returns True; per-tool ability to fire is gated at call-time.

tool_fanout.generate_card: ModelAPI.text(...) with strict-JSON system primer + JSON.loads validation + write to studio/assets/_workflows|_products|_agents/agent_defs/generated_<crystal_short>.json
tool_fanout.generate_image: core/lib/third_party/comfyui_mcp.py::ComfyUIMCPConnector.submit_workflow_and_wait('text_to_image', {'prompt': ...}) — falls back to .send('text_to_image', ...). Returns SendResult(success=False, error='comfyui_not_available') when the connector cannot be imported.
tool_fanout.generate_3d: TEXT-PLACEHOLDER for v1 — autonomous_modeler arrives in Phase B.3. Returns SendResult(success=False, error='autonomous_modeler not yet built (Phase B.3)') with the prompt + max_iter preserved in metadata for future replay.
tool_fanout.generate_app: POST http://localhost:8765/mcp/call with {tool: 'generate_app', args: {workflow_card_slug, target}} via stdlib urllib. Returns SendResult(success=False, error='replit_bridge_not_running') when the bridge is offline.

subordinate_connectors.hf_hub: core/lib/hf_hub.py::inference — HF router fallback (called via ModelAPI when DeepSeek misses)
subordinate_connectors.replit_bridge: studio/mcp/replit-bridge/server.py — Replit deploy bridge, FastAPI on port 8765 (POST /mcp/call)

env_vars.REPLIT_BRIDGE_URL: Override default http://localhost:8765/mcp/call (e.g. point at droplet)

substrate: studio/third_party/generative_mcp/ (per-config persistence) + ~/.cc/third_party_logs/generative_mcp_sends.jsonl (history) + ~/.cc/inference_master_chain.jsonl (crystal-anchored generative records, tier='generative'). Successful generate_card calls also write studio/assets/_workflows|_products|_agents/agent_defs/generated_<crystal_short>.json.

inbound_callers: Replit-deployed apps via the unified bridge
agents that want one single fan-out front door for all modalities
routing_connections.substrate_reads: nothing directly — subordinate connectors read their own .env / keys
routing_connections.substrate_writes: send_log entries + crystal_chain generative records + generated card JSON files

guarantees: Crystal-anchored — every successful tool call has a deterministic InferenceRecord with tier='generative', model='generative_mcp', scope='generative_<tool>', and forward_chain_inline=<subordinate_crystal> for end-to-end traceability
Graceful — every subordinate import is wrapped in try/except; a missing sibling returns SendResult(success=False, error='<sub>_not_available') for that one tool but never breaks the whole connector
Stdlib-only — no third-party HTTP client; urllib handles the one outbound POST to the Replit bridge
Meta-only — fans out, never calls a model itself; tier='generative' records always reference a sub_crystal from the underlying provider
No duplicated infrastructure — every modality reuses ModelAPI / DeepSeek / ComfyUI / Replit bridge as the source of truth
usage_example:
from core.lib.third_party.generative_mcp import GenerativeMCPConnector
c = GenerativeMCPConnector()
c.connect()
print(c.which_tools_available())
r = c.send('generate_text', '{"prompt":"hi","max_tokens":10}')
print(r.message_preview, r.crystal_id, r.metadata['sub_crystal'])
